# Chestnut Dental

> > Multi-specialty dental practice with Harvard-trained specialists offering pediatric dentistry, orthodontics, and cosmetic care across three Massachusetts locations.

Chestnut Dental is a family-focused dental practice founded in 1970, operating in Needham, Franklin, and Bedford, Massachusetts. The practice specializes in pediatric dentistry, orthodontics (including Invisalign), and comprehensive family dental care with a team of experienced, Harvard-trained dental professionals.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics
- Invisalign
- Family Dental Care

- [Chestnut Dental: Expert Dentists in Franklin, Massachusetts](https://chestnutdental.com/franklin-dentist): Comprehensive dental care in Franklin, MA with orthodontics & pediatrics
- [Comprehensive Dental Care in Bedford, MA | Chestnut Dental](https://chestnutdental.com/bedford-dentist): Top Bedford dentists offering orthodontics, cosmetics & pediatric care
